x: As a point of interest we had three members in the first twelve in the Civil Service Championship, viz: Baulch, Stroud and Hallowell. I would also like to congratulate Jack Brown on notching yet another championship win over the country.

Newell and Stroud were 4th. and 7th. respectively in the 1500 metres, Newell's time being 3m.58s. Alan Jackson and Dudley Gordon were finalists in the 400m. and a welcome entry in the 400m. hurdles was Brian Coleman.
